3d.description: Resets 3D parameters to defaults and starts, stops, or overlays 3D mode.

3dmode.description: Selects the Julibrot viewing mode, including monocular, left eye, right eye, or red-blue.

ambient.description: Sets the minimum light level, shadow depth, and contrast for light-source fill types.

background.description: Sets the red, green, and blue background color for full-color Targa output.

brief.description: Writes shorter ray tracing files by omitting per-triangle color data.

bright.description: Sets red and blue brightness compensation for red-blue stereo glasses.

coarse.description: Sets 3D preview coarseness and the triangle size used for ray tracing output.

converge.description: Sets stereo convergence and the overall separation of the two stereo images.

crop.description: Trims left and right edges of red and blue stereo image pairs.

filename.description: Restores a saved image or GIF as the starting point for a 3D transform.

filltype.description: Selects the 3D fill method used to render the transformed surface.

fullcolor.description: Writes full-color Targa output for light-source fill types.

haze.description: Adds distance haze to full-color light-source terrain output.

interocular.description: Sets stereo eye separation as a percentage of the screen.

julibrot3d.description: Sets Julibrot 3D depth, origin, height, width, and distance parameters.

julibroteyes.description: Sets the distance between the virtual eyes for Julibrot rendering.

julibrotfromto.description: Sets the source and destination coordinate range used for Julibrot rendering.

latitude.description: Sets the minimum and maximum latitude used by spherical projection.

lightsource.description: Sets the x, y, and z coordinates of the light-source vector.

longitude.description: Sets the minimum and maximum longitude used by spherical projection.

monitorwidth.description: Sets the physical image width in inches for random dot stereogram viewing.

perspective.description: Sets the viewer distance used for perspective in 3D transforms.

preview.description: Enables 3D preview mode before producing the final transformed image.

radius.description: Sets the radius scale factor for spherical projection.

randomize.description: Randomizes nearby colors to smooth altitude banding in 3D transformations.

ray.description: Selects the ray tracing output file format for 3D surfaces.

rds.description: Generates a random dot stereogram with optional depth, texture, and calibration settings.

rds-texture.description: Selects the texture image used instead of random dots for random dot stereograms.

rotation.description: Rotates the 3D transform around the x, y, and z axes.

roughness.description: Sets surface roughness as the z-axis scale factor.

scalexyz.description: Sets x, y, and z scale factors for the transformed 3D surface.

showbox.description: Shows the 3D preview bounding box before final rendering.

smoothing.description: Smooths rough images when using light-source fill modes.

sphere.description: Enables spherical projection for the 3D transform.

stereo.description: Selects the stereo image mode, including none, alternate, superimpose, photo, or pair.

stereowidth.description: Sets the physical image width in inches for random dot stereogram viewing.

targa_overlay.description: Overlays full-color light-source output onto an existing Targa file.

transparent.description: Sets the color range treated as transparent during 3D overlay.

usegrayscale.description: Uses grayscale brightness rather than color number as depth information.

waterline.description: Raises colors at or below this value to form the 3D water level.

xyadjust.description: Shifts the final 3D image in x and y without changing perspective.

xyshift.description: Shifts the 3D image in x and y while changing the perspective view.
